title: Anahat Singh Exits London Squash Classic Quarterfinals After Loss to Sivasangari
indian_angle: Indian teenager Anahat Singh faced a tough challenge from her Asian Games rival, Sivasangari, in the London Squash Classic quarterfinals.
summary: Indian teenager Anahat Singh was defeated by former champion Sivasangari, seeded third, in a comfortable 2-0 win for Sivasangari in 17 minutes at the London Squash Classic quarterfinals.

title: Diya and Yashaswini Secure All-Indian Semifinal Berth at WTT Contender Almaty
indian_angle: This result guarantees an Indian pair in the women's doubles final at the WTT Contender Almaty, showcasing strong Indian talent.
summary: Diya Chitale and Yashaswini Ghorpade have advanced to an all-Indian women's doubles semifinal at the WTT Contender Almaty, where they will face Syndrela Das and Sutirtha Mukherjee.

title: Vishesh Sharma Claims Maiden Professional Title at Telangana Golconda Masters
indian_angle: Young Indian golfer Vishesh Sharma secured his first professional title on home soil, a significant milestone in his career.
summary: 19-year-old Vishesh Sharma clinched his maiden professional golf title at the Telangana Golconda Masters, rising to 14th on the 2026 Order of Merit with earnings of ₹30,93,550.

title: India's Fastest Man Gurindervir Singh Prepares for Asian Games Comeback
indian_angle: India's fastest man, Gurindervir Singh, is overcoming challenges to prepare for the upcoming Asian Games, aiming to regain control of his career.
summary: Gurindervir Singh, India’s fastest man, has faced a challenging period since breaking the 10.1-second barrier but is determined to perform well at the Asian Games despite recent injuries and questions.

title: BCCI Bans Bengal Leg-Spinner Rohit Yadav for 2 Years Over Age Fraud
indian_angle: The BCCI's two-year ban on Rohit Yadav for age fraud highlights the ongoing efforts to maintain integrity in Indian domestic cricket.
summary: The BCCI has banned Bengal leg-spinner Rohit Yadav for two years due to age fraud. Yadav, originally from Uttar Pradesh, had represented India during the Under-19 team's tour of Sri Lanka in July.
